name: Crunches
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Rest your fingertips lightly beside your head, elbows out.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders a few inches off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your stomach.
Lower your shoulders back down with control.
cues: Lower back stays on the floor
Keep a fist of space under the chin
Breathe out as you curl up

common_mistakes.mistake: Pulling on the head with the hands
common_mistakes.fix: Fingertips only touch the head; let the stomach do the work
Lift only the shoulder blades off the floor
Lower over 2 seconds and keep tension
